metaDescription: Authorization, tenant boundaries and auditability for ISB Security Platform: who may act, in which context, and what is recorded.
title: Who may perform what, in which context, with what record.
intro: Role-based access, company-scoped data and audit foundations are established. Privacy retention and legal-hold governance are in discovery. Conceptual paths only — no certification is claimed, and no production policy logic is exposed.
authDescription: Same officer identity. Different tenant context. The boundary holds.
trustDescription: Each layer constrains the next. Deeper than the homepage overview.
ctaTitle: Review the control model with ISB.

flow.allowedNote: Who can perform what, inside which organizational context, with what traceability.

audit.title: Conceptual audit trail · illustrative
audit.footer: Operational actions leave traceable records. Not a claim of legal immutability.

trust.sr: Trust architecture layers: Identity, Role and Permission, Tenant Context, Object and Customer Context, Data Access, Operational Action, Audit Event, Storage and Infrastructure. Designed around least-privilege access and tenant-aware separation. No certifications claimed.

layers.label: Identity
layers.purpose: Authenticated user and organization context form the first access boundary.
layers.control: User identity · organization context · assignment context

layers.label: Role & Permission
layers.purpose: Designed around least-privilege access — what a user may view, create, approve or manage.
layers.control: Role scopes · officer / supervisor / customer / administrator

layers.label: Tenant Context
layers.purpose: Tenant-aware data separation between organizations and their customers.

layers.label: Object / Customer Context
layers.purpose: Operational data scoped to the objects and customers a role may access.
layers.control: Object hierarchy · customer scope · assignment linkage

layers.label: Data Access
layers.purpose: Architecture supports row-level security controls and server-side validation.
layers.control: Role + tenant + object context · API boundaries · coverage expanding

layers.label: Operational Action
layers.purpose: Sensitive actions occur only after identity, permission and context checks.
layers.control: Create/approve report · update instruction · assign · escalate

layers.label: Audit Event
layers.purpose: Traceable operational actions — critical changes and approvals associated with users.
layers.control: Action logging · change history · approval association

layers.label: Storage & Infrastructure
layers.purpose: Production infrastructure controls remain subject to deployment validation.
layers.control: Controlled storage · environment separation · access discipline
